fact: Officials are assigning addresses to citizens at region, council, ward, street and village level under the National Address Programme (NaP) launched in Zanzibar, which aims to give a digital address to all citizens, per Biometric Update citing The Citizen.

The digital ID address system went operational in Zanzibar in June 2025 and over 450,000 digital addresses have been assigned to people and plots, says the Zanzibar Construction, Communication and Transport Minister.
The Higher Education Students' Loans Board (HESLB) has used the digital address system since June 2025, with over 489,409 students applying for loans digitally, per The Citizen.
The Zanzibar ministry reports issuing 29,475 digital introduction letters through the addressing system between July 2025 and March 2026.
The Minister for Communications and IT said in the April 2026 budget plan that the government will continue to improve the Physical Addressing and Postcode system (Daily News).
The Citizen reports the Communication and IT Minister directed all public and private institutions to adopt the national residential addressing system.

Tanzania's ICT ministry says it trained accommodation, food and tourism providers in Dar es Salaam to register their businesses on the National Physical Addressing system (NaPA) ahead of AFCON 2027; the release gives no date for the training, so its published date of 2026-11-24 is used.
